organizations.publicNote: Pathé's record business passed to Columbia Graphophone in 1928 and became Pathé-Marconi in 1936. The 1934 record imprint represented here is therefore distinguished from the earlier Pathé Frères authority entity.

sources.shortCitation: Pathé PA362, “Vivons l’amour, vivons la vie” (Guy Berry, 1934)
sources.fullCitation: Guy Berry. “Vivons l’amour, vivons la vie”, from the Casino de Paris revue Parade de France. Music-hall song by Walter Jurmann, Bronisław Kaper, Henri Varna and Marc Cab. Pathé PA362, matrix cpt-1514-1, 25 cm needle-cut electrical disc, 78 rpm, recorded October 1934. Phonobase record 15273; transfer made 4 February 2023 from the Christian Declerck collection, Dunkirk. Accessed 16 August 2026.
sources.title: Vivons l’amour, vivons la vie — Pathé PA362, Guy Berry
sources.creator: Guy Berry
sources.researchNote: The Phonobase record additionally states that Tino Rossi created the song in 1934, that Mireille, Guy Berry and Priolet also performed it, and that Coda / Heugel published it in Paris in 1934.
